name: Python dev tooling (ruff, mypy, pytest, mkdocs, helix)
description: Installs standard Python dev tooling via pixi: ruff, mypy, pytest, pytest-cov, mkdocs, mkdocs-material, mkdocstrings, the Helix editor, and pyright. Also writes ~/.config/helix/languages.toml wiring Helix's Python support to ruff's native LSP (lint/format) and pyright (hover/completion/go-to-definition). Works with both base-ubuntu and base-cuda images.
